GUI.note:
Assessment
2024-06-03 portal/chart review, no new in-person examination. Crystal Emmerich, DOB 1968-04-04, MRN SYN-2826062 verified. Reviewed 5/31 portal message, primary care 5/17 note, podiatry 3/25 note, medication list, problems and laboratory/microbiology results.
Most likely terbinafine-induced subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus (SCLE), not confirmed yet. Since early May, mildly pruritic red annular/polycyclic scaly plaques with central clearing on upper back, V of neck and outer forearms; exacerbated by sun/gardening, face spared. At 5/17 assessment no mucosal lesions, mouth ulcers, joint pain, swelling or synovitis; well appearing. Portal message reports spread despite oral and topical antifungals, especially in sun-exposed areas.
Prior working diagnosis tinea corporis is not supported by the overall course: 5/17 upper-back scraping KOH showed no fungal elements and culture finalized 5/31 with no growth at 14 days. Antifungal exposure may reduce test sensitivity, but photodistribution, morphology and progression on therapy strongly favor SCLE over dermatophyte infection. Nail PAS positivity confirms separate toenail onychomycosis, not a fungal cause of this rash.
